no_preview_declaration: No seed in 130001..130036 has ever been instantiated, previewed, counted for eligibility, smoke-tested, or debugged with, on any generator family or in any pipeline stage. A repository-wide search of the working tree and all git history before this seal found the block only as inert textual declarations in the protocol, runner, tests, and this seal, plus coincidental digit collisions inside retained float values of prior result artifacts. An earlier draft of the protocol named 70101..70136 as the eval block; that block is numerically contained in the 2-complex experiment's unsealed train block 70001..70200 and was discarded unopened under the series' strict no-preview standard; no member of it is used in this experiment. If even one sealed seed is accidentally instantiated before execution, the entire block is void and a new block must be chosen and verified absent. There is no train seed block: the loop experiment has no learned model and no training; the empty block is recorded as the sentinel {first: 0, last: 0}.

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of 1{out-of-library: the alarm fired, discovery certified, the novelty gate admitted, and map_misfit <= 1e-9}
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound (alpha = 0.05/4, Student-t critical value for the eligible n) exceeds 0.95 (the system's end-to-end acquisition claim)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of 1{null-control: NOT admitted}
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0.95 (no false constraint is admitted on structure-free observations; a route-mode outcome admits nothing)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of 1{in-library: routed to the true target (routed_index == 0)}
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0.95 (the loop does not regress routing on in-library instances)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of 1{in-library: the alarm did NOT fire}
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0.95 (the loop only discovers when no library structure truly fits)

stop_rules: Any preflight mismatch: seal-validation failure (unknown seal key at any level including inside a claim object, descriptive claim subfields missing or blank, tampered claim field, design_commit absent from history or not an ancestor of HEAD, the imported universa package not resolving under the project's src), hash mismatch, seal not committed at HEAD, on-disk seal not byte-identical to its HEAD blob, symlinked seal/protocol/runner, dirty worktree, existing output path, available CUDA, or (when torch is importable) torch thread count other than one.
A worktree found dirty, a code-manifest hash found changed, or the on-disk seal, protocol, or runner file found changed at the end-of-run re-check before publishing a complete result.
A raw-row count violating the frozen invariant 3 x |eligible seeds| (one in-library row, one out-of-library row, and one null-control row per eligible seed).
An instance-build exception: whole-run design_failure, never an exclusion; the offending seed is recorded, the run stops, no seed is ever deleted alone.
Fewer than 30 eligible seeds (the build and the undegraded audit): design_failure_insufficient_eligible with no loop execution and no claims.
Any determinism failure (including the double-execution bit-identity check), NaN, audit (other than the per-seed eligibility gate), rank, or validation failure: whole-run design_failure.
Aggregation failure or a non-finite estimand.
Any manual cancellation or infrastructure interruption: interrupted.
No outcome-dependent stopping, no interim analysis, no sample-size extension, no seed-level deletion.
Never rerun because results are surprising, weak, null, or apparently decisive; any code, tolerance, dependency, or analysis change after a partial run invalidates the seed block.
